title: 最长快乐字符串
summary: 使用不超过给定数量的 a、b、c 构造不含三个连续相同字符的最长字符串。
insight: 每步优先使用剩余最多的字符；若它会形成三连，就临时使用次多字符，次多不存在时已无法继续。
pitfalls: 字符数量只要求不超过给定值
使用次多字符后要把最大字符放回堆
同频时固定字母序以生成确定结果

solutions.title: 最大堆贪心
solutions.idea: 优先消耗数量最多且不会形成三连的字符。
steps: 把正频次字符以数量降序、字母升序入堆
弹出最多字符；若答案末两位相同则改取次多字符并放回最多项
追加所选字符、频次减一后仍有剩余则放回，直到堆空或无法选择

code.java: class Solution { public String longestDiverseString(int a,int b,int c){PriorityQueue<int[]> heap=new PriorityQueue<>((x,y)->x[0]!=y[0]?Integer.compare(y[0],x[0]):Integer.compare(x[1],y[1]));if(a>0)heap.offer(new int[]{a,'a'});if(b>0)heap.offer(new int[]{b,'b'});if(c>0)heap.offer(new int[]{c,'c'});StringBuilder answer=new StringBuilder();while(!heap.isEmpty()){int[] first=heap.poll();int length=answer.length();if(length>=2&&answer.charAt(length-1)==first[1]&&answer.charAt(length-2)==first[1]){if(heap.isEmpty())break;int[] second=heap.poll();answer.append((char)second[1]);if(--second[0]>0)heap.offer(second);heap.offer(first);}else{answer.append((char)first[1]);if(--first[0]>0)heap.offer(first);}}return answer.toString();} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun longestDiverseString(a:Int,b:Int,c:Int):String{val heap=java.util.PriorityQueue<IntArray>{x,y->if(x[0]!=y[0])y[0]-x[0] else x[1]-y[1]};if(a>0)heap.add(intArrayOf(a,'a'.code));if(b>0)heap.add(intArrayOf(b,'b'.code));if(c>0)heap.add(intArrayOf(c,'c'.code));val answer=StringBuilder();while(heap.isNotEmpty()){val first=heap.remove();val length=answer.length;if(length>=2&&answer[length-1].code==first[1]&&answer[length-2].code==first[1]){if(heap.isEmpty())break;val second=heap.remove();answer.append(second[1].toChar());second[0]--;if(second[0]>0)heap.add(second);heap.add(first)}else{answer.append(first[1].toChar());first[0]--;if(first[0]>0)heap.add(first)}};return answer.toString()} }
code.cpp: class Solution { struct Compare{bool operator()(const pair<int,char>& a,const pair<int,char>& b)const{return a.first!=b.first?a.first<b.first:a.second>b.second;}};public:string longestDiverseString(int a,int b,int c){priority_queue<pair<int,char>,vector<pair<int,char>>,Compare> heap;if(a)heap.push({a,'a'});if(b)heap.push({b,'b'});if(c)heap.push({c,'c'});string answer;while(!heap.empty()){auto first=heap.top();heap.pop();int length=answer.size();if(length>=2&&answer[length-1]==first.second&&answer[length-2]==first.second){if(heap.empty())break;auto second=heap.top();heap.pop();answer+=second.second;if(--second.first)heap.push(second);heap.push(first);}else{answer+=first.second;if(--first.first)heap.push(first);}}return answer;} };
